---
title: "Diagram alternative text"
format:
  html: default
  docx: default
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
    pdf-standard: ua-1
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        -
          - 'pre.mermaid-js[data-fig-alt="Mermaid alternative text"]'
          - '#fig-dot svg[role="img"][aria-label="DOT alternative text"]'
          - '#fig-mermaid figcaption'
          - '#fig-dot figcaption'
          - 'pre.mermaid-js[data-fig-alt="Uncaptioned Mermaid alternative"]'
          - 'svg[aria-label="Uncaptioned DOT alternative"]'
        - []
    docx:
      ensureDocxXpath:
        -
          - '//wp:docPr[@descr="Mermaid alternative text"]'
          - '//wp:docPr[@descr="DOT alternative text"]'
          - '//wp:docPr[@descr="Uncaptioned Mermaid alternative"]'
          - '//wp:docPr[@descr="Uncaptioned DOT alternative"]'
          - '//wp:docPr[@descr="Static alternative"]'
          - '//w:t[contains(., "Mermaid visible caption")]'
          - '//w:t[contains(., "DOT visible caption")]'
          - '//w:t[contains(., "Static visible caption")]'
        - []
    typst:
      noErrors: default
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - 'alt:\s*"Mermaid alternative text"'
          - 'alt:\s*"DOT alternative text"'
          - 'alt:\s*"Uncaptioned Mermaid alternative"'
          - 'alt:\s*"Uncaptioned DOT alternative"'
          - 'alt:\s*"Static alternative"'
        - []
---

See @fig-mermaid and @fig-dot.

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-mermaid
%%| fig-cap: "Mermaid visible caption"
%%| fig-alt: "Mermaid alternative text"
flowchart LR
  A[Start] --> B[End]
```

```{dot}
//| label: fig-dot
//| fig-cap: "DOT visible caption"
//| fig-alt: "DOT alternative text"
digraph G { Start -> End }
```

```{mermaid}
%%| fig-alt: "Uncaptioned Mermaid alternative"
flowchart LR
  A[Start] --> B[End]
```

```{dot}
//| fig-alt: "Uncaptioned DOT alternative"
digraph G { Start -> End }
```
